run_image_traversal: run image traversal on an image using a trained MERU or CLIP model checkpoint
interpolate_features: interpolate between an image feature vector and the root feature across N steps
calc_similarity_scores: calculate similarity scores between image features and text features for MERU or CLIP models
get_text_features: retrieve and encode captions, nouns, and adjectives from the Pexels text dataset
review_main: review the main function that loads a model, encodes an image, and prints nearest neighbor texts
